meta.project: KIS Afterschool and School Bus Integrated Management System

product_overview: The product helps parents manage afterschool-related bus participation and supports staff in coordinating afterschool enrollments with school bus operations. It also gives administrators tools to manage afterschool student data and configure custom bus destination zones and fares.
core_goals: Let parents access their dashboard and complete bus-related checkout workflows for their children.
Enable staff to manage afterschool student information, including bulk course and student data handling.
Allow bus administrators to create custom destination groups, assign fares, and map destinations for school bus pricing.
Support teachers in checking student boarding status and tracking boarding progress for bus lines.

features.name: Parent Dashboard and Bus Checkout
features.description: Parents access a portal to review and complete bus-related actions for their child as part of the afterschool flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /parents/login -> Enter parent login credentials -> Submit login form -> See parent dashboard
Navigate to /parents -> Review child’s bus participation details -> Complete checkout-related action -> See updated parent dashboard

features.name: Afterschool Master Administration
features.description: Administrators and teachers manage afterschool student records and perform bulk course or data operations.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/afterschool -> Upload an Excel file for bulk course creation -> Review imported classes in the administration panel
Navigate to /admin/afterschool -> Open student management -> Edit student information and bus mapping -> Save changes -> See updated student list
Navigate to /admin/afterschool -> Download the school banking Excel template -> Populate student data offline -> Upload the completed file -> See the merged student records
Navigate to /admin/afterschool -> Review the full student list across all classes -> Export school banking data for administration use

features.name: Custom Bus Fare Setting
features.description: Bus administrators create destination groups, assign fares, and map destinations to those groups for school bus pricing.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/bus -> Create a custom destination group name -> Set a VND fare amount for the group -> Save the new fare group -> See it added to the destination list
Navigate to /admin/bus -> Choose a local destination from the mapping list -> Assign it to a custom destination group -> Save the mapping -> See the updated destination group assignment
Navigate to /admin/bus -> Download the destination mapping template -> Update destinations in the file -> Upload the completed file -> See the bulk destination mapping applied
Navigate to /admin/bus -> Select a custom destination group -> Remove the group -> Reassign affected destinations to a default zone -> See the destination list updated

features.name: Student Bus Boarding Check
features.description: Teachers use a realtime checklist to mark students as boarding or leaving bus routes and to monitor boarding progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /teacher/bus -> Select an assigned bus line -> Mark an individual student as boarded -> See the boarding status update
Navigate to /teacher/bus -> Select a boarded student -> Switch the student to another route or unboard the student -> See the student’s status change
Navigate to /teacher/bus -> Review the boarding progress statistics -> See the total boarding progress for the current bus line
